recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: Classic Italian pasta with garlic, chili and olive oil.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Sauté sliced garlic and chili flakes in olive oil.
Toss the pasta in the pan and finish with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Crisp romaine with grilled chicken, parmesan and croutons.
instructions: Grill the chicken breast until cooked through, then slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and top with chicken, parmesan and croutons.

recipes.title: Veggie Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: Colorful bowl with roasted vegetables, quinoa and tahini.
instructions: Roast the sweet potato and chickpeas at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Cook the quinoa according to the package.
Assemble the bowl with spinach and drizzle with tahini.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Thin crust pizza with tomato, mozzarella and fresh basil.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250°C with a baking stone inside.
Stretch the dough, spread the tomato sauce and add the mozzarella.
Bake for 8 minutes and top with fresh basil.

recipes.title: Grilled Salmon with Lemon
recipes.description: Juicy salmon fillets with lemon, dill and steamed green beans.
instructions: Season the salmon with salt, lemon zest and dill.
Grill for 4 minutes on each side.
Serve with steamed green beans and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Slow-cooked arborio rice with mushrooms and parmesan.
instructions: Sauté the onion and mushrooms in butter until golden.
Add the rice and stir in the hot stock one ladle at a time.
Finish with parmesan and butter, stirring until creamy.
